title: Megurine Luka — Sharing My Shine〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: KAITO, about the lighting for this song. Wouldn't something bluer be better?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A deeper blue may help create a better atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A deeper blue?
Then, I'll go get the color filters from the back.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, can we talk about our schedule? I'd like to discuss when we're going to practice the song we're going to sing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Five, six, seven, eight...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're both in perfect sync♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you two looked like a single unit when you lifted your arms and struck that pose at the end!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. We did practice quite a bit♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks for watching, MEIKO, Len!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
Next, would you mind watching us dance?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Looks like we're all preparing rather nicely.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We should have quite a lot of time to practice and rehearse if things keep going this smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?! That's good news since we need to practice and rehearse a lot to make our show one to remember.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We owe you quite a lot for coming up with such a good schedule for us, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we really can't ask for a better manager.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I believe things are going smoothly because we're all doing our part.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, I asked you to all gather today in order to try on costumes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, finally.
I've been waiting so long♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure you all have ideas of what you'd like to wear, so feel free to start by trying on the costumes you already have in mind.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Okay♪
Okay.
Dressing Room

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... Which song and costume should I start with...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Miku, let's pick out the costumes for our song♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay!
It's a pretty upbeat song, so how about something with vibrant colors?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Len.
I've finished restitching that costume you asked me to.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You have? Thanks, KAITO, you're a lifesaver! It's one I really want to wear.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, I should start finding the right costume for myself♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's so wonderful how you're able to spread so much hope as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And you shine so brightly each time you take the stage. I get a huge boost of encouragement whenever I see you perform...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To shine my brightest as an idol, I need the right costume.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (One that gives me the confidence to shine like a star.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (One that gives me the power to spread hope to all those watching our show.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This section seems like a good place to look.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... This color suits me, but I'll be singing songs that the girls originally sang...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Something closer to their theme would be...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
This costume...!
It's just what I was looking for!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Miku, look here!
Isn't this lovely?
